Hello, I'm GodofGrunts.

A [not so] quick telling of my journey to becoming a free speech advocate.

When I was young, my parents sent to me to a private christian school. Of course, religion was the most important thing here and academics were a subproject.

3rd grade comes around and we move to a different state. I attend a public school for the first time. Whoa! What a difference! Not only did I find out that I was really far behind in math/science/english, but I also found out that my poor feelings weren't going to be protected by all these mean kids.

At first, I was upset. I cried (I was 9-10 after all) and told my parents, parents went to the school, but nothing really came of it.

I soon befriend a chinese kid who rode my bus. One day, the bullies started picking on me again and my friend stood up for me. The bullies proceeded to call my friend things like "slanty eyes" and "ching chong" and such. Eventually recess ended and we went back inside.

On the bus ride home, I asked him if he was upset about what they said. I can't remember his exact words, but he quoted some Buddhist stuff that basically meant that you create your own happiness or whatever.

Over time, as I grew up, I started having opinions that didn't line up with my mom's. This caused a lot of issues between us and she would use her position as a parent to silence me. This pissed me off. Of course I lashed out. I started getting into the local punk scene listening to such bands as Highway Magic, The Jerkwads, The Unlovables who are semi-famous for this spot on Adult Swim. Also, a lot of more main stream bands such as System of a Down(not punk I know), Sum 41, Blink 182 etc.

I'm not sure if the music influenced me or if it was my mindset that influenced the type of music I listened too, but I started to form the opinion that it didn't matter what anyone wanted me to say and I didn't really care what they had to say.

Angsty right? Eventually, I grew out of the whole "Fuck everyone else, Imma do me" and it really turned into more of "As long as we're not hurting anyone or anything just let us be".

With that territory comes a lot of things that I defend now.

Anyway, just wanted to drop by and say hi.
